info.name: Factset Analytics Datastore About Linkup API
Returns the  daily files from Open:FactSet Partner - LinkUp. The LinkUp API provides access to job listings dataset that is sourced directly from employer webistes globally delivered daily.

params.name: _sort
params.description: Enables to get the data in ascending or descending order based on startTime. Results are in reverse chronological order if this parameter is not used.

params.name: _paginationLimit
params.description: Specifies the maximum number of results to return per result.

params.name: _paginationOffset
params.description: Specifies the starting point for pagination. This parameter is used to identify the beginning of next set of results. Using this parameter can fetch maximum of first 10000 records.

params.name: startDate
params.description: The earliest date of the LinkUp file the API should fetching for based on fileTimestamp.

params.name: endDate
params.description: The latest date of the LinkUp file the API should fetching for based on fileTimestamp.

params.name: type
params.description: Used to provide the full job descriptions when value "full" is used for this parameter.

items.docs: Returns the  daily files from Open:FactSet Partner - LinkUp. The LinkUp API provides access to job listings dataset that is sourced directly from employer webistes globally delivered daily. **This API is no longer being sold for new clients.**
